title: Q-CRED-CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is invalid
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation credwatch --probe CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
**Status:** open

TOKEN-EXPIRY-1: `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` (every deploy workflow and the watchdog) is invalid; expiry not reported. Move every loop that uses it to a route that does not (GitHub's per-run token, the deploy gateway's OIDC route) and renew it through the connect flow.
